excerpt: Plan realistic monthly and annual cleaning spend for a 1,800 sq ft growing team office approaching the 2,500 sq ft rate threshold. Learn how cleanable-area measurement, restroom counts, and full-service add-ons shape commercial bids.
quickAnswer: The cost to clean a 1,800 sq ft office with two restrooms on commercial carpet averages $263 to $449 per visit ($1,140 to $1,943 per month) for weekly service, $235 to $402 per visit ($3,058 to $5,226 per month) at 3x/week, and $224 to $384 per visit ($4,858 to $8,314 per month) for 5x/week weekday coverage. Including breakroom, interior glass, consumables, and quarterly floor care raises 3x/week monthly budgets to $3,743 to $6,699.

blocks.text: A 1,800 sq ft suite—home to a growing 10-to-15 person team with a dedicated conference room, breakroom bar, reception area, and two private restrooms—sits near the upper edge of the **Under 2,500 sq ft** commercial rate tier (**$0.12 to $0.20 per sq ft**). Because your footprint has not yet crossed into the **2,500 to 9,999 sq ft** bracket (**$0.09 to $0.15 per sq ft**), per-square-foot unit rates stay elevated even as monthly retainers become a top-five facilities expense.

At this scale, accurate **cleanable square footage** and strict **add-on scoping** prevent hundreds of dollars per month in avoidable bid bloat. Below is the complete monthly and annual maintenance model calibrated to our [US national janitorial pricing benchmarks](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/).
1,800 Sq Ft Monthly & Annual Cleaning Spend by Frequency

At the **1.00x national multiplier** on commercial carpet (1.00x) with **two private restrooms** (**$15 to $30 per restroom per visit**), growing team suites typically choose either **2x/week** (**$2,130 to $3,637/mo**), **3x/week** (**$3,058 to $5,226/mo**), or **5x/week** (**$4,858 to $8,314/mo**). Monthly retainers use the **4.333 weeks/month** calendar standard (4.33 in our estimator), equating to 8.66, 13.0, and 21.65 average visits per month.

blocks.title: Cleanable vs. Rentable Square Footage Saves 8%–12% Immediately
blocks.text: Commercial leases often quote 2,000+ rentable sq ft for a 1,800 sq ft cleanable suite once common corridors, HVAC closets, and locked server rooms are counted. Subtracting 150 to 200 non-cleanable sq ft from your RFP keeps your baseline quote aligned to true cleanable space rather than padded lease footage.
Flooring Mix, Restroom Counts, and Full-Service Add-On Spend

Growing 10-to-15 person suites see real traffic around kitchenettes, conference glass, and restroom soap dispensers. On a 1x/week carpeted baseline, moving from **0 private restrooms** (**$233–$389/visit**, **$1,010–$1,684/mo**) to **1 restroom** (**$248–$419/visit**, **$1,075–$1,813/mo**) or **2 restrooms** (**$263–$449/visit**, **$1,140–$1,943/mo**) adds $65 to $130/month per fixture.

Meanwhile, switching from **polished concrete (0.95x)** to **ceramic tile and grout (1.12x)** lifts a 3x/week contract by **$454 to $756 per month**. Adding **breakroom sanitation** (**$12–$25/visit**), **interior glass partitions** (**$15–$35/visit**), **consumables** (**$21.60–$45/visit** at $0.012–$0.025/sq ft), and **amortized quarterly deep floor care** (**$54–$108/mo** at $0.03–$0.06/sq ft) moves a 3x/week carpeted retainer from **$3,058–$5,226/mo** up to **$3,743–$6,699/mo** (**$44,921 to $80,388 annually**).

blocks.text: Labor Hours and Route Mobilization at 1,800 Sq Ft

Under ISSA production metrics (**2,800 to 4,000 sq ft/hr** plus **0.15 to 0.25 hours per restroom**), active cleaning across 1,800 sq ft and two restrooms takes roughly **45 to 68 minutes**, fitting neatly inside a **1.00 to 1.25 billed labor hour** service block. On a 3x/week plan, implied billing equals **$188 to $402 per hour** because commercial dispatch, supervisory audits, and insurance amortize over a short nightly visit—compared against **$35 to $65 per hour** for continuous day-porter labor and **$55 to $95 per hour** for specialty carpet extraction or VCT stripping.
Nimble Backpack Vacuums for Growing Team Suites
To keep cycle times tight across open desks, conference partitions, and high-traffic breakroom floors without interrupting late-working staff, top contractors deploy nimble HEPA backpack vacuums:

items: **Makita XCV17Z 36V LXT Brushless Backpack Vacuum:** Offers a compact 2.0 L capacity, HEPA filtration, 9.9 lb frame, and 36V LXT cordless operation for rapid daytime crumb and conference-room touch-ups.

**Milwaukee M18 FUEL 3-in-1 Backpack Vacuum:** Delivers a 1 gal canister, HEPA filter, 15 lb convertible design, and M18 Brushless motor capable of tackling desk edges, upholstery, and overhead air returns.

**Karcher BV 5/1 Commercial Backpack Vacuum:** Pairs a 1.3 gal canister and Fleece plus HEPA filtration with an 11.7 lb harness, telescoping wand, and quiet 62 dBA output built for consistent evening floor sweeps.

blocks.title: Approaching the 2,500 Sq Ft Bracket Drop
blocks.text: Because 1,800 sq ft sits in the Under 2,500 sq ft tier ($0.12–$0.20/sq ft), expanding into a [2,500 sq ft office](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/cost-to-clean-a-2500-sq-ft-office/) triggers the next bracket ($0.09–$0.15/sq ft). At 2,500 sq ft, a 3x/week carpeted suite with two restrooms runs roughly $272 to $467/visit—meaning you gain 39% more space for only ~16% higher spend.
5 Steps to Control Monthly Cleaning Spend in a 1,800 Sq Ft Suite
Apply these procurement controls before renewing your current contract or onboarding a new janitorial vendor.

items.name: Match Cleaning Frequency to Hybrid Occupancy
items.text: If all 12–15 team members are only in-office Tuesday through Thursday, dropping from 5x/week ($4,858–$8,314/mo) to 3x/week ($3,058–$5,226/mo) saves $1,800 to $3,088 every month.

items.name: Separate Restroom Supplies From Labor Retainers
items.text: Compare vendor consumables ($21.60–$45/visit) against direct bulk ordering of jumbo roll tissue, foam soap, and high-density can liners.

items.name: Require Green Seal GS-37 & OSHA Compliance
items.text: Specify Green Seal GS-37 or EPA Safer Choice neutral cleaners, OSHA HazCom (29 CFR 1910.1200) Safety Data Sheets, and Bloodborne Pathogens (29 CFR 1910.1030) restroom protocols.

items.name: Audit Certificate of Insurance & Bonding
items.text: Collect an up-to-date COI with $1M/$2M General Liability (Additional Insured), statutory Workers' Compensation, and fidelity bonding.

items.name: Benchmark Adjacent Size Brackets
items.text: Compare your quotes with our [2,000 sq ft office](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/cost-to-clean-a-2000-sq-ft-office/) and [3,000 sq ft office](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/cost-to-clean-a-3000-sq-ft-office/) guides if you anticipate another headcount expansion.

faqs.q: What is the average monthly cost to clean a 1,800 sq ft office?
faqs.a: At US national averages with two restrooms and commercial carpet, a 1,800 sq ft office averages $1,140 to $1,943/month for weekly service (1x/week), $2,130 to $3,637/month for 2x/week, $3,058 to $5,226/month for 3x/week, and $4,858 to $8,314/month for daily 5x/week weekday care.

faqs.q: Why do 3x/week cleaning quotes multiply per-visit cost by 13.0 instead of 12?
faqs.a: A 52-week calendar year divided across 12 months averages 4.333 weeks per month (4.33 in rounded pricing engines). Multiplying 3 weekly visits by 4.333 equals 13.0 visits per month, preventing fifth-week service skips or surprise invoices.

faqs.q: How much do breakroom sanitation, glass partitions, and consumables add at 1,800 sq ft?
faqs.a: Breakroom detailing adds $12 to $25/visit, interior glass partitions add $15 to $35/visit, vendor consumables add $21.60 to $45/visit ($0.012–$0.025/sq ft), and amortized quarterly floor care adds $54 to $108/month ($0.03–$0.06/sq ft)—lifting a 3x/week carpeted quote from $3,058–$5,226/mo to $3,743–$6,699/mo.

faqs.q: What is excluded from routine 1,800 sq ft office cleaning rates?
faqs.a: Base per-square-foot contracts exclude hot-water carpet extraction, VCT floor stripping and waxing, inside-refrigerator cleanouts, high ceiling dusting above 8 feet, exterior windows, restroom paper supplies, and OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens (29 CFR 1910.1030) biohazard remediation.

faqs.q: What insurance and safety rules must a 1,800 sq ft janitorial contractor satisfy?
faqs.a: Always collect a Certificate of Insurance (COI) verifying $1,000,000/$2,000,000 Commercial General Liability naming your company and landlord as Additional Insured, statutory Workers' Compensation for W-2 employees, a fidelity bond, and OSHA HazCom (29 CFR 1910.1200) Safety Data Sheets.
